topic: Colleges can't hold your original certif
hook: Colleges can't hold your original certificates over unpaid fees
hook_b: Colleges can't hold your original certificates over unpaid fees
tldr: Telangana HC: a college cannot retain original certificates as security for unpaid fees.

beats.what: The High Court held that colleges cannot retain students' original certificates as security for unpaid fees.
beats.why: Students often need originals for jobs, higher studies and visas.
beats.care: If a college is holding your originals, you can cite this ruling when asking for them back.

event.label: HC bars holding originals as security

steps.e: College holds original certificates over unpaid fees

cover.label: originals can't be held for fees

sources.name: Verdictum
sources.title: College Cannot Retain Students' Original Certificates As Security For Unpaid Fees: Telangana High Court

fact: Telangana High Court says colleges cannot keep students' original certificates as fee security.
twist: The ruling is about holding originals as security, not about waiving the fees.
